claims.text: A UCCA node can be either a terminal or a non-terminal, but not both.
UCCA uses non-terminal nodes to represent units comprising more than one word, indicating that nodes can be non-terminals.
UCCA nodes correspond to either a single terminal or several terminals viewed as a single entity, confirming the distinction between terminal and non-terminal nodes.
